title: Opening up solos and who takes a chorus
summary: Basie says the band can open up arrangements any time, nobody plays the same solo twice, and he points to who takes a chorus.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment
